protocol.name: camera_ready_delivered_mask_audit_v1
protocol.view_rule: slices 0,4,...,96 of each selected volume (num_slices=100 grid)
protocol.pairing: Within each audit seed, every arm sees the identical crop of every view (seed_all(seed + view) before each loader call; soft and hard loaders asserted equal), the identical batch composition, the identical 4 target + 1 context rectangle sizes per batch (torch.Generator(seed)), and the identical placement seed (seed_all(seed + batch_start)) before each arm.
protocol.guidance: set_epoch(50, 100): r_t = 1 for every guided arm

tissue_proxies.soft: PRIMARY common scoring proxy: patch occupancy >= 0.25 of the schema-2 MIRAGE soft-guide envelope (summed P_inner+P_choroid >= 0.5), same proxy as the published tables: D:\jepa_phase0\fairvision-glaucoma\mirage_soft_guides\base512_enc_ad4f09adfa9f05f0b_m31a932eef403c3e8_npy
tissue_proxies.hard: secondary: patch occupancy >= 0.25 of the repaired hard MIRAGE envelope (ENVELOPE's placement product): D:\jepa_phase0\fairvision-glaucoma\mirage_guides

definitions.context_pct_grid: delivered encoder context tokens C_b / 256 (after batch equalisation), image mean
definitions.unique_targets_U: distinct delivered target cells per image
definitions.loss_slots_L: delivered target index slots per image (npred x K_b), duplicates included
definitions.purity_pct: tissue-proxy cells among the U unique delivered targets (ratio of means)
definitions.anatomy_hidden_pct: tissue-proxy cells hidden as targets / all tissue-proxy cells
definitions.context_tissue_share_pct: tissue-proxy cells in delivered context / all tissue-proxy cells

protocol.warning: Mask-audit seeds are sampler replays, not pretraining seeds; the historical training masks were not recorded.
